title: Persist the missing sdlc stat schema
objective: Add the persisted schemas/sdlc/stat/v1/sdlc-stat.schema.json contract for the sdlc stat response and align the implementation with that durable schema.

branch.name: main
branch.rationale: The repository is already on the main branch and the user requested preparation, processing, and commits on the current repository.

request.text: Prepare WI-0005 to add the missing persisted sdlc/stat/v1 schema for the sdlc stat command. WI-0004 introduced the sdlc stat response shape but missed persisting its schema. Add the schema under schemas/sdlc/stat/v1/ and commit the work item.

scope.name: persist-stat-schema
scope.description: Add schemas/sdlc/stat/v1/sdlc-stat.schema.json for the stable sdlc stat JSON response envelope.
scope.reason: The schema-first convention requires every output object to have a persisted versioned schema.

scope.name: align-stat-contract
scope.description: Align the stat runtime identifier, representative fixtures, and validation evidence with the persisted sdlc/stat/v1 contract.
scope.reason: The implementation currently exposes the response identifier inline and must select the durable repository/type/version contract.

nonGoals.name: new-stat-semantics
nonGoals.description: Do not change stat path selection, tracked-file behavior, metadata fields, object-kind behavior, or read-only semantics beyond schema alignment.
nonGoals.reason: WI-0005 repairs the missing persisted schema contract introduced by WI-0004.

nonGoals.name: provider-and-production-runtime
nonGoals.description: Do not add provider calls, HTTP services, persistence, deployment, or production release behavior.
nonGoals.reason: The work item is limited to a local JSON Schema contract and its validation alignment.

items.name: persisted-stat-schema
items.description: A closed JSON Schema 2020-12 document must be persisted at schemas/sdlc/stat/v1/sdlc-stat.schema.json with the stable sdlc/stat/v1 identifier and the complete stat response shape.
items.reason: WI-0004 introduced the stat response but missed the persisted schema required by the repository convention in .cline/README.md.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The schema exists at schemas/sdlc/stat/v1/sdlc-stat.schema.json, declares $id https://schemas.handschuh.dev/sdlc/stat/v1, is closed, and validates a representative sdlc stat response.
The complete repository schema audit discovers and passes the new sdlc/stat/v1 schema.

items.name: stat-schema-alignment
items.description: The stat implementation and tests must identify the response contract as sdlc/stat/v1 and preserve the existing response keys and behavior.
items.reason: A persisted schema is only useful when the runtime response selects the same repository/type/version contract.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The stat runtime and focused tests use sdlc/stat/v1, and all existing stat tests continue to pass.

items.name: missed-schema-traceability
items.description: The work item must explicitly identify WI-0004 as the source work item that introduced the stat response without persisting its schema.
items.reason: The omission must remain traceable so the schema-first convention failure is not repeated.

acceptanceCriteria.description: WI-0005 records a sourceWorkItem reference to WI-0004 and describes the missed persisted schema in its request, scope, or requirements.
